targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-08-03 failure_autopsy, V3-EXQ-862a, confirmed]: 862a fixed both prior config bugs (475b's z_harm_a wiring, 862's dacc_weight=0 consumer gain) and both preconditions pass, but the ON/OFF manipulation itself never engaged: code-verified (vs_gate_held_e1/e2_z_harm_a = 0 across all 3 seeds), the borrowed 490b threshold (0.85, applied globally) never crosses for z_harm_a's own V_s -- the ON arm's held-budget lands entirely on z_beta instead. PE and bias-magnitude series are bit-identical between arms per seed. non_contributory -- this is a third, independent manipulation-check gap, not a substrate finding; Q-040.c's mechanism-quantification question remains untested. Route: same-question letter (862b) with per-stream threshold calibration + a z_harm_a-specific engagement precondition.
learning_extracted: A stream-level V_s gate threshold borrowed wholesale from a different target experiment (490b) does not transfer -- z_harm_a's own V_s never crosses the borrowed 0.85 threshold in this harness, while z_beta does.
An aggregate 'any stream held' precondition (vs_gate_total_held) is structurally blind to a per-channel failure -- it passed while the one stream (z_harm_a) the DV depends on never engaged.
The gate's own e1_threshold_per_stream/e2_threshold_per_stream override dicts exist to prevent exactly this and were not used.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-08-03 failure_autopsy, V3-EXQ-870a, confirmed]: first V3 run. FAIL is a design/measurement gap, not evidence against the dissociation hypothesis: in 3/6 seed x arm cells, evaluation episodes terminate (mean 8-20 of 80 steps) well before the contingency switch at step 40, leaving execution_strength=NaN and near-zero post-switch data; the design's only non-degeneracy check silently passes on 2/3 (not 3/3) OFF seeds due to NaN-filtering. In the 3 well-powered cells, post_switch_toward_new_frac reads near-zero regardless of arm -- a floor effect that may reflect either genuine replanning-stickiness or DV insensitivity, but the censored cells never had a chance to inform C1 at all. non_contributory. The execution-strength DV design itself (avoiding SD-032b/MECH-260's committed-action-entropy floor-lock) is validated as sound -- this FAIL does not reproduce that known ceiling. Route: same-question letter (870b) with a per-cell switch-step-reached precondition and termination-cause recording.
learning_extracted: Survival censoring: 3/6 cells terminate episodes (mean 8-20 of 80 steps) well before switch_step=40, leaving the post-switch window structurally unreached -- not condition-linked (hits both ON and OFF cells across different seeds), most plausibly a hazard-collision interaction.
The non-degeneracy precondition's NaN-filtering list comprehension silently reduces N (2/3 not 3/3 OFF seeds) without flagging reduced sample size -- reports met:true with false confidence.

Even in well-powered cells, post_switch_toward_new_frac reads near-zero in 2 of 3 -- a floor effect independent of dACC arm, suggesting either a genuine replanning-stickiness property or a DV-sensitivity gap (resource_field_decay=0.5 vs proximity_benefit_scale=0.12 close to proximity_harm_scale=0.1).

MECH-480's execution-strength DV design (routing around SD-032b/MECH-260's committed-action-entropy floor-lock) is validated as sound in principle -- the gap is upstream of the DV, not the DV's construct validity.
No formalized targeted_review_mech_480 literature entry exists yet despite the Asaoka 2026 citation already being identified in claims.yaml prose -- low-priority /lit-pull commission to close.

cluster_pattern.shape: Two structurally different bugs (a globally-applied, wrongly-calibrated per-stream V_s gate threshold vs. an environment survival-censoring gap) converge on one property: each experiment's own precondition/acceptance-gate checked engagement in AGGREGATE (any of six V_s streams held; any nonzero sample from 2 of 3 seeds) rather than on the SPECIFIC slice (the z_harm_a stream; the post-switch window per cell) the primary DV actually reads -- so both preflight checks reported 'met' while the load-bearing slice never engaged.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: Coarse/aggregate precondition checks are structurally blind to a per-channel or per-cell failure in the specific slice a primary DV depends on. Recommend future /queue-experiment authoring in this dACC-adjacent cohort assert engagement of the exact substrate slice (stream / time-window / cell) each primary DV consumes, not merely 'some' nonzero engagement anywhere in the design.
